metadata.article_title: Execution by High Court of decree transferred by other Court.

article.title: Execution by High Court of decree transferred by other Court.
article.content:
9Execution by High Court of decree transferred by other Court.

Order 21, Rule 9
Where the Court to which the decree is sent for execution is a High Court, the decree shall be executed by such Court in the same manner as if it had been passed by such Court in the exercise of its ordinary original civil jurisdiction.
